changelog:
本次版本修了亿个 Bug，完善了主动消息，并且添加了许多智慧功能，让 AI 更加智能，且兼容了各种文档的修改。

增添：
1. 二维码生成、图片处理、批量文件处理与表格数据处理
2. Word / PPT / Excel 结构化读写、文档格式互转与符号数学计算
3. 离线 OCR 兜底、数据格式互通与通用文本对比
4. 代码静态检查功能，自动接入并支持 JSON/YAML 真解析
5. 酒馆模式快捷开关与模式说明，模仿酒馆请求模式减少角色卡拦截；搜索工具描述按模式分叉
6. 二进制分析能力拆成 7 个独立可开关工具，内置 Rizin+Ghidra 逆向引擎与独立反汇编引擎
7. 聊天内直接显示图片
8. 精简每轮固定开销（memory_tool 描述压掉 844 字符），APK 体积再降 9MB（109MB → 100MB）

修复了：
1. 卡片正则替换的三处连锁缺陷，前端卡片终于能渲染；无语言标注围栏包裹的 HTML 文档卡无法识别
2. 世界书预算裁剪角色卡条目、RAG 记忆未加相关性下限、记忆与对话关联丢失
3. 酒馆工具判断在 fallback 路径遗漏、记忆工具未隔离、第二条生成路径未裁剪、搜索工具条件错误、提示词固定开销过大
4. 证书摘要校验公式不一致、插件解密注入失效、JNI 符号名与 R8 混淆导致插件解密失效
5. 逆向工具链三处致命缺陷、ELF 段表读取字节序错误、文件模式地址定位失效、hex 模式地址回归、并发上限未生效、参数透传与输出边界问题
6. release 包打开助手设置页闪退（R8 删掉序列化子类）、sealed 序列化闪退、深度思考无法关闭、酒馆模式残留近期对话、主题样式无法重置、长会话流式生成主线程卡顿
7. 主动消息错误导致清空聊天记录与记忆、后台定时彻底失效、改了设置不生效、间隔下限异常、发送到错误对话、对话选择器不可见、执行日志不显示原因、被误判为「用户打断」、失败后无限重试刷屏
8. 对话归属被错误改写、聊天记录被静默截断、消息附件被误删除、删除消息静默失效、消息列表变少未被拦截、全局圆角过大、弹窗选项渲染成一排独立大圆钮

────────────

This release fixes a huge number of bugs, improves proactive messaging, and adds many smart features that make the AI far more capable. It also improves compatibility with editing of various document formats.

Added:
1. QR code generation, image processing, batch file handling, and spreadsheet data handling
2. Structured Word / PPT / Excel read-write, document format conversion, and symbolic math
3. Offline OCR fallback, cross-format data interoperability, and general-purpose text diff
4. Code static analysis, wired in automatically with real JSON/YAML parsing
5. Tavern mode quick toggle and notes, mimicking tavern request patterns to reduce card filtering; search tool descriptions branch by mode
6. Binary analysis split into 7 independently toggleable tools, with a built-in Rizin + Ghidra engine and a standalone disassembler
7. Images shown inline in chat
8. Trimmed per-turn fixed overhead (memory_tool description cut by 844 chars); APK down another 9MB (109MB to 100MB)

Fixed:
1. Three chained defects in card regex replacement that broke front-end cards, and HTML document cards without a language fence were not recognized
2. World book budgeting trimmed character card entries, RAG memory had no relevance floor, and memories lost their link to conversations
3. Tavern tool branching was missing on the fallback path, memory tools were not isolated, the second generation path was not trimmed, the search tool condition was wrong, and fixed prompt overhead was excessive
4. Inconsistent certificate digest formula, broken plugin decryption injection, and plugin decryption broken by JNI symbol names and R8 obfuscation
5. Three critical defects in the reverse toolchain, wrong ELF section table byte order, broken file mode address resolution, a hex mode addr regression, an ineffective concurrency limit, plus argument passing and output boundary issues
6. A crash when opening assistant settings in the release build (R8 removed serialization subclasses), a crash from sealed serialization, deep thinking that could not be turned off, tavern mode leaving recent conversations behind, theme styles that could not be reset, and main-thread jank during streaming in long conversations
7. Proactive messaging could erase chat history and memories, scheduling failed in the background, settings changes had no effect, the interval lower bound was wrong, messages went to the wrong conversation, the conversation picker was invisible, the log hid its reason, runs were wrongly reported as interrupted by the user, and failures caused endless retry spam
8. A conversation could be reassigned to the wrong assistant, chat history could be silently truncated, attachments deleted by mistake, message deletion silently failed, a shrinking message list was not intercepted, global corner radii were oversized, and dialog options rendered as a row of separate large pills
